lane_policy.REAL_MODEL_B01_HOLD: Exactly two real-model-gated tests. No paid/provider request until B01 monetary hard bound and separate Root model scope; cost remains null.
lane_policy.LOCAL_NODE_MU_TLS: Pinned Node/Mu bundle and local TLS/SDK/child resources required. Provider inference is not inferred by SDK name.
lane_policy.LOCAL_NATIVE_CHILD: Pinned compiler/binaries/host tools, finite process/IO/OS lifecycle scope required.
lane_policy.CONDITIONAL_SKIP_REVIEW: Resource or platform gate may skip; any actual skip blocks whole-suite qualification.
lane_policy.LOCAL_HTTP_FIXTURE_REVIEW: Local HTTP construction signal; no public network authorization inferred.
lane_policy.STATIC_NO_RESOURCE_SIGNAL_REVIEW: No signal in bounded name graph; side-effect freedom and offline safety NOT established.

qualification_rule: Every target-platform test and all 58 packages must be accounted for by fresh Go graph/list, actual single-run exit and per-test PASS; FAIL/SKIP/missing/unexpected/timeout/output-cap breach leaves whole58 false. Independent source signer must be established, never inferred from prior CLI2/Desktop qualifications.
